ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails of several fraud cases in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scandal.
questions: What are the sources of funding for these fraudulent schemes?
How are the perpetrators laundering their money?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money in these fraud cases could lead to a deeper understanding of the schemes and potentially identify other suspects or co-conspirators.
